card.summary: ジャンルから未閲覧ツールを探し、選んだツールの詳細だけ読み込む

spec.description: Explore tools by category. categories returns counts and unseen totals; list returns the next unseen summaries in a category (including subcategories). search optionally finds unseen tools by name or natural-language query. Listing/searching never loads definitions. describe loads one named tool's full spec and makes it callable. reject records why a named tool is unsuitable and unloads its schema. reset explicitly starts exploration over. Progress spans all categories and queries within the current user request and survives restart; a new user request starts fresh. Repeating list/search advances to unseen tools, not the same page. Exhausted results include remaining category counts.

action.description: Start with categories, then list, then describe.

category.description: Required for list. Exact category or parent prefix; '*' lists all categories.

query.description: Required for search. Tool name or natural-language request.

name.description: Required for describe/reject. Exact tool name from a summary.

reason.description: Why the selected tool is unsuitable (reject).

spec.usage_notes: Start with categories, list the relevant category, then describe only the tool you choose. If unsuitable, reject it and continue listing; check other categories with remaining > 0. Do not reset just to get the same results again.

discovery.kernel_note: Discover tools via tool_search(action='categories'), then action='list' with category, then action='describe' with name before use. Repeated lists/searches show unseen tools; reject unsuitable tools and explore remaining categories.

card.summary: アーティファクト参照の中身を部分閲覧する

spec.description: Partially inspect the value stored behind an artifact reference ({"$artifact": "..."}).

query.description: 中身から探したい内容

range.description: 行範囲(例 '10-40')やキーパス(例 'items[0].name')

spec.usage_notes: プレビューで足りない時のみ使う。全量展開は避け、queryかrangeで絞る。

discovery.kernel_note: Inspect what an artifact holds with peek(artifact=..., query=..., range=...) rather than asking for the whole value.

card.summary: 折り畳まれた過去の会話をイベント台帳から検索する

spec.description: Search the append-only event ledger for this run, including messages folded out of the live conversation by compaction. Use when working_state doesn't have enough detail.
